Chest heaviness aur saans lene mein takleef ke saath-saath aap jo mental stress mehsoos kar rahe hain, uske liye turant medical help lena hi sabse sahi kadam hai. Please kisi family member ya dost ko abhi phone lagayein ya emergency services ko call karein. Aapka kaam ka schedule kaisa rehta hai—day shift, night shift ya rotational?
